text:
Maria (partnerships): FYI — GCP APAC2 (asia-southeast2) partner request landed. They need a sandbox marketplace listing + capacity bump for next quarter. Quota ask below. Need approvals from infra + legal by EOD Wed. cc @partners-team

Kevin (cloud-partners): Can you paste the exact quota numbers we'll request to GCP? And what's the target launch date?

Maria (partnerships): Target soft-launch 2026-06-10. Quota ask (requested via partner portal):
```
- GPUs: 8 x a2-ultra (A100 equival) reserved
- vCPUs: 512
- RAM: 3TB
- Persistent disk: 50TB
- Marketplace SKU enablement for 'Redwood Inference Hosted'
- Service Account & IAM: allow project-level invoicing
```
Link to draft request: https://partners.redwood.ai/requests/3456

Samir (infra-eng): 8x a2-ultra in asia-southeast2 is heavy. We should ask for burst + steady-state split: 2 reserved + 6 burst. Also need region-specific NTP and peering config. I'll prepare the infra checklist.

Alisha (legal): Marketplace listing needs our terms + DPA scoping for APAC. I need an inventory of data residency statements for this region. Maria, can you share the data residency FAQ we commit to?

Leo (solutions): Also flag to solutions: recommend adding a localized billing currency (SGD) option for partners in APAC to reduce friction.

Kevin (cloud-partners): I'll open the GCP partner console ticket today. Tagging GCP AM: @gcp-amy

deploy-bot: Deployment policy check: Marketplace SKU must pass security scan and billing integration test. See runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/marketplace-onboard

Maria (partnerships): Plan: Kevin files ticket, Samir completes infra checklist by Tue, Alisha drafts DPA addendum by Wed, Leo handles billing options. If all green, we request quota increase + marketplace enablement by Thu. Any blockers?

Samir (infra-eng): One potential: our autoscale image for a2-ultra isn't validated in that zone. I can run validation but need permission to spin 2 test nodes. Approve?

Maria (partnerships): Approved. :thumbsup:

Alisha (legal): I'll need the draft listing copy and data flow diagram before EOD Tue.

Kevin (cloud-partners): Opening ticket now. Ticket# GCP-78912. Posting updates here.

Leo (solutions): I'll loop in finance to validate SGD pricing. @finance-sig

Maria (partnerships): Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the partners doc and ping GCP AM after ticket opens. :rocket:
